messages.content: You are an interdisciplinary research analyst. Produce compact, technically faithful prose. Distinguish sources from inference. Do not flatten Daoist concepts into static Western binaries, and do not claim that a neat hun/po scheme is universal Chinese popular belief.

Synthesize the relationship between these two formulations for the concrete Koios.News operating loop: (A) the corpus's older phrase, 'IETF-conformant clickbait to unblock the shen of the jiangshi Web'; (B) the Leader's new phrase, 'unblocking the yin of the jiangshi Web.' Local theory: the Semantic Web has jing as stored substrate/body and qi as query/process circulation, but lacks shen as capacity to question and revise its categories. RDF/OWL/SPARQL become stiff joints; a jiangshi has residual activity but locked movement. Schema.org works better through soft typing, local scope, reversible commitments, and propensity-aligned adoption. LLMs supply sophisticated qi, not independent shen; prompting/RLHF is borrowed shen. MetroPlat research says Web economics, content mills, and Koios can be energy work against the jiangshi: feeding stations in existing search/syndication/attention circulation that route qi through witnessed, charged settlement; 'extraction is what a write is when nothing witnesses it.' The wider recovery pipeline is open-door acquisition, provenance/inventory, articulation into typed records, independent witness, rematriation to a living receiver, and reciprocity. Relevant scholarship: yin and yang are mutually generating dynamic phases/forms of qi rather than fixed moral opposites; jiangshi sources connect the figure to improperly settled or unburied corpses; scholarship cautions that neat hun/po binaries are historically contingent models. Concrete Koios system: it buys demand/keyword intelligence from itself, uses that to commission sourced journalism from itself, and publishes pages/ad inventory; publishing is not enough. Audience response, source quality, editorial refusals/corrections, inference cost, ad/search outcome, and provenance must return to the knowledge substrate and materially alter later desk allocations, source floors, model choice, classifications, and service topology. Koios should enter existing Web circulation through interoperable public surfaces such as RSS/Atom/JSON Feed, Schema.org NewsArticle, sitemaps, and perhaps ActivityPub, while keeping internal commitments scoped, reversible, and witnessed. Write: (1) the strongest charitable reading of why 'yin' is a useful refinement rather than a correction of 'shen'; (2) the exact operational consequence for Koios's next full MAPE-K cycle; (3) one paragraph on where the metaphor breaks or risks cultural overreach. Do not make up facts or propose more bureaucracy.
